name: Campfire
summary: Collaborative web platform for running AI coding agent sessions side by side, with replay, voting and 30+ integrations.
description: Web platform for running parallel AI coding agent sessions — Claude Code, Codex, Goose, Aider, OpenHands, OpenClaw, OpenCode — side by side in one browser tab, with real-time collaboration, permission voting, session replay and forking. Ships via npm, source, Docker or a macOS desktop app, with a documented CLI, REST API and WebSocket protocol.
contains: runs 7 agent backends side by side: Claude Code, Codex, Goose, Aider, OpenHands, OpenClaw, OpenCode
real-time collaboration with invite links and owner/collaborator/spectator roles
permission voting policies: majority-rules, any-deny-blocks, owner-decides
session replay at 1x/2x/4x/8x from JSONL recordings
fork & branch, session gallery, prompt library, cost dashboard
scheduled tasks, webhooks, Linear integration, 30+ integrations
run via npm, source, Docker or a macOS desktop app
documented CLI, REST API and WebSocket protocol
